scope: Executed development milestone; full v0.2 and RG-01–RG-11 remain incomplete

environments.x86_64: Native Linux x86-64 assembly interpreter executable
environments.qemu: QEMU 11.1.1 RISC-V virt reference, no firmware, LT-Dev-v2 guest
environments.aarch64: Linux ARM64 assembly interpreter executable executed under qemu-aarch64 on x86-64; not native ARM64 hardware

focused_execution.compiler_and_AEAD: Actual optimized guest workload / RFC8439 vectors and boundaries on QEMU; log commitments in component record

workflow: Boot fixed image once; post-boot source/data and original-publisher signed imports
Inspect and explicitly approve exact release identity and permissions
Three independent native clients plus launcher and user Objects/Vault services
64KiB transactional object import, revision, lineage, limited delegation, revocation and export
Process stop/relaunch, stale handle denial, faults/quotas, service restart and blocked-client cancellation
Publisher/project pinning, strict signed decoder, atomic release activation and explicit compatible rollback
Native semantic edit, host bootstrap build/sign, live REL reimport without OS rebuild
Object-scoped encrypted snapshot retention, reset/unlock recovery, wrong-key/corruption/readonly rejection
Actual inactive-bank-write interruption before root publication and recovery on all three backends
No-vault usable ephemeral sessions; lock and explicit logical deletion

lean_guest: Launcher release verification, trust, approval and activation
Vault devices mediation, AEAD format, retention and recovery policies
assembly: Separate x86-64 and ARM64 generic interpreters and documented Linux byte/block/entropy adapters
host_bootstrap: Pinned Lean IR elaboration/optimization and proof kernel
Python transport and disclosed source extraction/semantic validation/build/export tooling

limits: Development RV64IM/Sv39/legacy virtio subset, not completed LT-Machine-v1
12 process slots including idle and three trusted/service roles; bounded profile quotas
64KiB per object,64 records,256 grants; source profile capacities
One selected retained snapshot per vault root; no persistent app approvals or grants
Raw32-byte key provisioning; no passphrase KDF or key rotation implementation
Regular explicit development backing files, no physical external-drive or live hot-unplug validation
Nonce uniqueness and boot identity separation probabilistic; no trusted freshness against whole-store rollback
Logical deletion invalidates roots, not secure erasure of ciphertext or disclosed copies
Host and compiler/emulator/device implementation trusted; no complete binary/memory/crypto/storage proof
Host build/sign remains bootstrap; no completed native IDE or full Lean heap/closure/GC runtime
No native ARM64 hardware, independently administered builder or distributed node evidence
Graphical desktop, federation/catalog admission, remaining applications, privacy networks/payments/testnet and server durability incomplete
next_dependency: Graphical launcher/workbench on the same IPC and object graph; bounded multi-object retention and richer structured SDK values alongside it
